session.system_prompt: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES (no opening rule: the greeting is already in the history), with the prompt's two optional-argument rules restated for strict tools (phonic_client.PROMPT_RULES), then the call-so-far note
session.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions, as custom_websocket tools in strict mode (every field required, optional ones nullable; nulls are dropped before the tool runs), tool_call_output_timeout_ms 60000

history: the call so far, oldest first, appended to the system prompt as a note ('The call so far, oldest first. Carry on from here:'), since the service takes no history; no reply is asked for at the start, so it does not greet again
turn: its detector (vad_min_silence_duration_ms 800); the caller's line in 40 ms chunks at 16 kHz
reply: the words of its audio chunks between assistant_started_speaking and assistant_finished_speaking
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
